title: The Live Debt
premise: Sebastian Winterbourne, a deniable fixer for the Meridian Group—an embassy that exists on no map—receives a calendar invitation from their handler, dead for three days. The meeting is real, and walking into it means becoming the next name on a kill list tied to a Geneva summit. To survive, Sebastian must extract Dr. Ilse Marchetti, a defector whose testimony could topple the summit's architects—but every instinct says she is bait, dangled to flush out the last person loyal enough to come for her. Torn between duty to an organization that has already written them off and a growing love for the woman they were sent to retrieve, Sebastian discovers the invitation was sent by their handler before dying: a final act of loyalty meant to expose the truth. In the end, Sebastian chooses truth over the institution, burns the Meridian Group's ledger at the summit itself, and escapes with Ilse—not as assets, but as people.
about_author: Ulyana Quintana is a former diplomatic translator who spent a decade in cities that appear on maps but not in official records. She writes thrillers about the people history forgets to count.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Three days after handler Marcus Vane's funeral, Sebastian receives a calendar invite from his account for tomorrow, 0600, a café in Vienna. They verify it twice; it's authentic. The emotional beat is dread sharpened into resolve—the dead don't send meetings, so either Marcus isn't dead or someone wants Sebastian to believe otherwise.

chapters.title: Go-Bag Rules
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian, with flashbacks to Vane's mentorship. Sebastian packs the go-bag, wipes their flat, and reviews the rules Vane taught them: never attend your own funeral twice. A burner call from an unknown number whispers 'she's alive' before cutting out. The beat is grief weaponized into suspicion—Sebastian goes to the meeting knowing it may be a trap.

chapters.title: Six O'Clock, Vienna
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. At the café, no Vane—instead a courier delivers a phone containing one file: Dr. Ilse Marchetti, defector, currently held in a Meridian safehouse outside Bratislava, scheduled for 'disposition' before the summit. The file is signed with Vane's private cipher. Beat: cold clarity—Vane died sending this, and Sebastian is now holding the fuse.

chapters.title: The Defector's Room
chapters.summary: POV alternates between Sebastian surveilling the safehouse and Ilse inside it, cataloging her guards' routines with a prisoner's patience. Ilse knows she's bait but doesn't know for whom. The beat is two kinds of captivity mirrored—Sebastian's loyalty and Ilse's confinement—converging as Sebastian decides to go in tonight, ahead of schedule.

chapters.title: Extraction, Interrupted
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. The extraction half-works: Sebastian reaches Ilse, but the safehouse was expecting them—a second team arrives, and in the firefight they learn the ambush wasn't Meridian's standard protocol. Someone senior wants both of them dead quietly. Beat: adrenaline curdling into betrayal as they escape with proof the trap was internal.

chapters.title: What Ilse Knows
chapters.summary: POV Ilse. Hiding in a border-town motel, Ilse reveals her testimony: the summit's security framework is a laundering scheme for assassinations dressed as diplomacy—and Vane discovered it, which is why he died. She also admits she let herself be captured to reach someone inside. Beat: intimacy and doubt entwined as Sebastian falls for her while wondering if every word is rehearsed.

chapters.title: Loyalty Audit
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. The Meridian Group makes contact: Deputy Director Corvus offers full reinstatement and protection in exchange for delivering Ilse to Geneva 'for debrief.' Sebastian recognizes the language of disposition. They stall, buy time, and trace Vane's cipher to a hidden ledger. Beat: the moment loyalty becomes complicity—Sebastian lies to Corvus and keeps Ilse.

chapters.title: The Ledger
chapters.summary: POV alternating. The ledger names everyone the summit will bury, including Sebastian. Ilse decrypts the final layer using credentials only she possesses—confirming she was always more than bait; she was the backup key. Beat: trust cemented under fire as hunters close in and the pair realizes Geneva is the only place the evidence can be detonated publicly.

chapters.title: Summit Floor
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Under forged credentials, they infiltrate the summit. Corvus springs the trap mid-session, exposing Sebastian before the delegates—but Sebastian turns it, broadcasting the ledger to every delegate's terminal as Corvus orders the room locked. Beat: climax—truth deployed as a weapon, love declared in the open when Sebastian refuses the exit that doesn't include Ilse.

chapters.title: After the Burn
chapters.summary: POV Ilse, closing on Sebastian. The summit collapses into scandal; Corvus vanishes into the machinery he built. Sebastian and Ilse trade the go-bag for ordinary luggage and a train with no destination in mind. Final beat: quiet resolution—they visit Vane's unmarked grave, leave the burner phone on it, and walk away owing nothing to anyone but each other.
